summary_zh: 泰國環境部長宣布年底前將嚴查3,049家工廠的工業廢棄物管理，環保稽查趨嚴的痛點持續累積（本期共9次），製造商需盡快檢視廢棄物與排放管控流程。另東部經濟走廊前9個月新設企業7,491家、年減14.14%，註冊資本減少42.13%，顯示投資動能放緩。
summary_en: Thailand's environment minister will inspect industrial waste management at 3,049 factories by year-end, adding to the recurring pressure from tighter environmental audits (9 mentions). Meanwhile, new EEC company registrations fell 14.14% in the first nine months and registered capital fell 42.13%.
